title: RTP ED137 Improve dissection with req/rsp and text in info column
description:
Associate Request for Measurement Message (RMM) to its Measurement Answer Message (MAM) using request/response as in ICMP dissector.
Compute response time for RMM and determine dynamic delay measurement using Annex F formulas: using request/response association, we now know both time qualities.
Put additional features information in the info column for easier readability, especially New Measurement Request.
Remove unused field DDC unknown.
Added expert info: no response to RMM, RSSI index not compliant.

notes.body:
Forged example file: [rtp_ed137.pcap](/uploads/627791c6dc3645f881238e364ce08e30/rtp_ed137.pcap)
Contains following packers:
- No header extension (pure RTP)
- ED137 header extension with no additional features
- SQI with index=0
- several SQI with different methods and index values
- RSSI SQI with max+2 value (expert info)
- CLIMAX with relative then absolute time
- Radio remote control (single freq)
- RMM with different time quality fields values (including ED137C MAM)
- RMM without MAM response
- NMR ED137B and ED137C formats
